scope: Every Pali key and nonempty English segment in current Bodhi/Thanissaro translation JSON files. Sujato is excluded from this inventory; final inclusion needs a separate explicit scope decision.

defaults.directPaliReview: Not established by inventoried evidence unless currentPaliEvidence names the key; a credited key proves a local judgment or audit-row read, not complete verified correspondence.
defaults.independentVerification: Not established by this inventory for any key; reconcile additional historical evidence before commissioning further reads.
defaults.correspondence: Reviewed exact English-span/Pali-key coverage is not established by this inventory; dispositions remain unrecorded.
defaults.bodyKeysOutsideTranslatedSuttas: No English body in this inner sutta; retained for future coverage/omission/source-ownership disposition, outside targeted verse denominator.
defaults.otherPaliKeys: Headings, closing/summary material or blank Pali; outside targeted body denominator, still require final coverage disposition.
